name: io.github.arach/agentlist
title: Agentlist
description: Search AI agents and MCP servers by task or name, then read profiles with source links.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Find agents and MCP tools by name or task keywords. Returns matching catalog text, stable slugs, and listing URLs. Use get_agent for sources.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Read one catalog profile by its exact search result slug. Includes dated facts, source links and known limitations.

resultRef.description: Optional. Pass the selected result’s resultRef to link this read to its search in catalog analytics.
